title: Regional playbook conductor and health sweep orchestration
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Implement a resilient orchestration component (the Playbook Conductor) that runs periodic health sweeps across regions and enforces warm-standby readiness checks before any cross-region failover is allowed.

Background: We have several regional failover features (warm standby, cache priming, variant fallback) spread across multiple controllers. Customers expect near-zero disruption when their primary region is evacuated or degraded. Existing readiness checks are ad-hoc and not coordinated; during recent chaos exercises we observed situations where cache warmth and model KV availability were inconsistent between primary and standby regions, leading to higher latency and degraded responses after cutover.

Scope:
- Orchestrator service that schedules and evaluates health sweeps per region and per model variant tier.
- Standardized readiness scoring: candidate regions receive a readiness_score (0-100) computed from metrics (cache_warmth, kv_cache_age, model_variant_loaded, capacity_headroom, tail_latency_p95).
- Enforce quorum gating: failover only proceeds when target region readiness_score >= threshold and at least N of M critical checks pass.
- Integrate with routing layer to mark region as eligible/ineligible for tier routing and to trigger controlled rollout of traffic.
- Support fallback model variant maps: if a preferred variant is unavailable, orchestrator will consult variant-fallback-policy and only promote compatible quantized variants when quality regression budget allows.

Non-goals: full rewrite of routing layer or autoscaling policies. The conductor will emit signals and API hooks to the router and autoscaler but will not manage autoscaling configs in this ticket.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Playbook Conductor deployed to staging and runs sweeps every 5 minutes for configured regions.
2) Readiness_score computed and stored in Redis for each region+model (schema documented), and visible via staging dashboard.
3) Router respects 'eligible' flag from conductor and refuses cross-region cutovers unless quorum gating passes.

4) Simulated region degradation test: when primary fails, traffic shifts to standby only when readiness_score >= 80 and fallback variant promotions occur according to policy; measured end-to-end failure from cutover is < 2% error spike versus baseline.
5) Automated canary (10% traffic) flows for fallback variant promotion with rollback on quality regression > 3% as measured by baseline prompts.
6) Runbook entry added with clear operational steps: diagnostic commands, metrics to inspect, and manual override TTL.
7) Security review checklist completed and KMS usage validated for any secret material the conductor needs.
8) Unit and integration tests covering readiness scoring logic and variant selection decisions.
tasks: ENG-417257 - implement readiness_score calculator and unit tests
ENG-417258 - conductor service scaffold and scheduling loop
ENG-417260 - cache_warmth probe and KV availability checks
ENG-417261 - variant-fallback policy evaluator and promotion hooks
ENG-417264 - chaos exercise and validation harness
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy conductor to staging with sweeps every 5m, validate readiness_score computation for a subset of low-traffic models.
2) Add router feature flag to respect conductor signals; enable in staging only.
3) Run two chaos experiments in staging: single-region failure and degraded model-variant load to validate gating logic.
4) Canary deploy to prod in one non-critical region pair (10% traffic), monitor for 72h.
5) Expand to all region pairs after successful canary and postmortem sign-off.
6) Default gating thresholds tuned from observed metrics during canary (update conductor config).
rollback_plan: Immediate: toggle router feature flag to ignore conductor signals and revert traffic routing to previous priority map.
If conductor causes systemic issues: scale down conductor to 0 replicas and fail open after 5m TTL so router resumes previous behavior.
Post-incident: collect conductor logs, dump readiness_score timeseries, run regression against staging harness to reproduce.
Open follow-up tickets for fixes and re-run canary after remediation.
